🚨 More than 105,000 cases in England have waited over a year for NHS treatment.

Royal College of Surgeons analysis shows 52-week waits rose from 94,404 in March to 105,711 in June - nearly 12% in three months.

It follows ten straight months of falling long waits. That progress was real. So is this reversal - recorded in every region.
